description: This file defines a helper class for logging in Android applications. It provides static methods to log messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT) and manages a chain of LogNode objects for log processing.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Helper class that provides static methods for logging messages at various levels and managing LogNode chain.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode that will receive log messages.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Sends a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable to the current LogNode.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level with optional Throwable.
